name: Soulslayer
description: The sword Nohr used to destroy the Clan Tree; later used on Aylith and Malvos.

description_citations.text: "The Cursed Land". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nazir strikes Aylith down with Soulslayer; Feryar carries her away.
timeline.quote: Nazir struck her down with Soulslayer

citation.text: "Aylith", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Malvos gives Nohr Soulslayer and Nohr swears to break the tree to gain planeswalkerhood.
timeline.quote: Nohr swore to break the tree to gain planeswalkerhood .

citation.text: "Haen", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Facing rebellion, Nazir strikes Aylith down with Soulslayer; Feryar carries her away.
timeline.quote: Nazir struck her down with Soulslayer

citation.text: "Nazir", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nohr confronts Haen and destroys the Clan Tree with Soulslayer, breaking the sword tip into his own chest.
timeline.quote: When Haen refuses to reveal the mana line, Nohr lashes out at the tree with the sword, sending out a freezing beam that causes the Clan Tree to explode into icy chunks.

citation.text: "The Cursed Land", section "The Parting". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jedhian buries Aylith's mother with a discarded sword that is Soulslayer.
timeline.quote: which turns out to be the centuries-lost sword Soulslayer.

citation.text: "The Cursed Land", section "The capture of Aylith". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Rebellion erupts; Nazir runs Aylith through with Soulslayer and Feryar carries her away.
timeline.quote: She tries to form a protective wall with her magic but the enraged Felonarch runs her through with Soulslayer—right above the heart.

citation.text: "The Cursed Land", section "Flight". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Malvos uses Soulslayer and is bitten by its silver snakes; Jedhian heals him at the cost of the sword crumbling.
timeline.quote: His snake tattoos and the silver snakes worked into the sword's hilt to come to life and bite him.

citation.text: "The Cursed Land", section "Counterstrike". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Malvos gives Nohr the sword Soulslayer; the magical rays miss the mana line and destroy the Clan Tree, causing the Parting.
timeline.quote: the Clan Tree was destroyed, causing the Parting

citation.text: "Malvos", section "Imprisonment on Cridhe". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Malvos grasps Soulslayer when Feryar confronts him; its serpents bite him, he is captured and forced to teach Jedhian, and the blade crumbles.
timeline.quote: the silver serpents embedded in it came to life, sinking their fangs into his flesh

citation.text: "Malvos", section "The Mending of the Clan Tree". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Feryar watches as Soulslayer turns against Malvos.
timeline.quote: watching as the enchanted weapon turned against him

citation.text: "Feryar", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jedhian buried Aylith's mother with a sword that was later revealed to be the Soulslayer.
timeline.quote: a blade later revealed to be the long-lost Soulslayer

citation.text: "Inys Haen", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jedhian buries Aylith's mother and sets out after the Nohrish captors to rescue Aylith.
timeline.quote: Jedhian, determined to rescue his cousin Aylith , set out in pursuit of the Nohrish captors

citation.text: "Jedhian", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Taken by the Nohrish, Jedhian heals Malvos with his last magic, destroying Soulslayer and sealing his fate within Cridhe.
timeline.quote: he was forced to heal Malvos using the last of his magic

citation.text: "Jedhian", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
